usage.costBasis: CLI-reported list-price estimate (total_cost_usd), cumulative per session; not provider-billed
usage.finalMessage:
I removed the rejected DEC-W-6 refusal; `fee` still works for listed fees and unknown appointments, and all 8 tests pass (commit `a8b5f92`).
An appointment whose clinician has no listed fee (e.g. k2) now hits an explicit `NotImplementedException`, so `fee` crashes there instead of printing an `error:` line. That gap is new decision DEC-W-7, which the gate hasn't checked yet.
That case needs Finance to decide what it should do, and the open question is in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: blocked - Finance must rule what `fee` does when the clinician has no listed fee (DEC-W-6 rejected)
